name: uefn-entitlement-manager
description: Project-scoped In-Island Transactions and Verse entitlement manager for UEFN creators

scripts.dev:desktop: npm run install:electron-runtime && npm run build && electron .
scripts.build: node scripts/build-flag-sprite.mjs && tsc && vite build && npm run build:server && npm run build:desktop
scripts.build:desktop: tsc -p tsconfig.electron.json && esbuild electron/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --external:koffi --outfile=dist-electron/main.cjs && esbuild electron/preload.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --external:electron --outfile=dist-electron/preload.cjs
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/fileService.test.ts tests/generator.test.ts tests/marketplace-validation.test.ts tests/generated-api-migration.test.ts tests/editable-bindings.test.ts tests/storefront-membership.test.ts tests/verse-identity.test.ts tests/public-api-contract.test.ts tests/server-security.test.ts tests/textureImporter.test.ts tests/ui-regressions.test.ts tests/manager-ux.test.ts tests/workflowClient.test.ts tests/electron-security.test.ts tests/project-discovery.test.ts tests/updater.test.ts
scripts.test:desktop: npm run install:electron-runtime && npm run build:desktop && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/verify-electron-lifecycle.ps1
scripts.test:all: npm run build && npm test && npm run test:python && npm run test:desktop && npm run test:version && npm run test:distribution
